sections.label: Sterilization, shelf life and packaging validation
sections.authority: FDA sterility review guidance; ISO 11135 / 11137 / 17665 as applicable

sections.label: Software / firmware documentation

sections.label: Cybersecurity documentation
sections.authority: FD&C Act §524B — required in a premarket submission for a cyber device. For an eSTAR, FDA's technical screening checks that the attachment is there.

sections.label: Financial certification or disclosure (FDA 3454 / 3455)
sections.authority: 21 CFR Part 54 — required where clinical data are submitted

sections.label: Combination-product constituent information
sections.authority: 21 CFR Part 4; cross-labelled constituent parts

sections.label: Implant-specific labeling and long-term performance
sections.authority: Implantable-device labeling and duration-appropriate testing

sections.label: CLIA waiver by application / dual submission
sections.authority: CLIA — applies to IVDs seeking waived status

sections.label: Electrical safety, EMC and wireless coexistence
sections.appliesWhen: the device is electrically powered or uses wireless communication
sections.authority: IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2; AAMI TIR69 for wireless

sections.label: Human factors / usability engineering
sections.appliesWhen: the device has critical tasks whose use error could cause harm
sections.authority: IEC 62366-1; FDA guidance "Content of Human Factors Information in Medical Device Marketing Submissions" (2026) — the eSTAR asks for HF Submission Category 1, 2 or 3 (HFE/UE report Section 1, Sections 1-4, or Sections 1-8)

sections.label: Reprocessing instructions and validation
sections.authority: FDA reprocessing guidance

sections.label: Declarations of Conformity (FDA 3654)
sections.appliesWhen: the submission relies on a recognised consensus standard
sections.authority: Form FDA 3654 — required for each recognised consensus standard relied on

sections.label: 510(k) Summary or 510(k) Statement
sections.authority: 21 CFR 807.92 (summary) or 807.93 (statement) — one or the other is mandatory

sections.label: Analytical performance (precision, detection limit, linearity, interference)
sections.authority: FDA IVD eSTAR — Performance Testing › Analytical Performance › Assay Performance

sections.label: Method comparison study
sections.appliesWhen: the assay is compared against a comparator or reference method
sections.authority: FDA IVD eSTAR — "Did you perform Method Comparison Study?"

sections.label: Validation of specimens / matrix comparison
sections.appliesWhen: more than one specimen type or matrix is claimed
sections.authority: FDA IVD eSTAR — "Did you perform Validation of Specimens/Matrix Comparison Study?"

sections.label: Reference range / expected values
sections.appliesWhen: the assay reports a quantitative or semi-quantitative result
sections.authority: FDA IVD eSTAR — "Do you have Reference Range/Expected Values information to include in this submission?"

sections.label: Stability of specimens
sections.appliesWhen: specimens are stored or transported before testing
sections.authority: FDA IVD eSTAR — "Did you perform Stability of Sample(s) Study?"

sections.label: Metrological traceability of calibrators and controls
sections.appliesWhen: the assay reports a value against a calibrator
sections.authority: FDA IVD eSTAR — "Do you have Traceability information to include in this submission?"

sections.label: Assay cut-off
sections.appliesWhen: the assay reports a qualitative result against a cut-off
sections.authority: FDA IVD eSTAR — "Did you perform Assay Cut-Off Study?"

sections.label: Carry-over
sections.appliesWhen: the assay runs on an automated analyser that processes specimens in sequence
sections.authority: FDA IVD eSTAR — "Did you perform Carry-Over Study?"

sections.label: High-dose hook effect
sections.appliesWhen: the assay is a sandwich immunoassay or otherwise subject to hook effect
sections.authority: FDA IVD eSTAR — "Did you perform High Dose Hook Effect Study?"

sections.label: Clinical performance (clinical sensitivity and specificity)
sections.appliesWhen: the intended use makes a claim about clinical performance
sections.authority: FDA IVD eSTAR — "Do you have Clinical Sensitivity and/or Clinical Specificity to include in this submission?"
